recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; revisit only if a future work-group decision reintroduces a separate Identifier-valued source element or changes reference-identifier search expectations.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 request to split Consent.source searching into a reference search limited to Consent, DocumentReference, Contract, and QuestionnaireResponse plus a token search for identifiers, while leaving attachment search out of scope.
initial_application: Source history shows the generic Consent source search row was split into source-reference and source-identifier in 96e8cdaec5; 7c8a912aeb later carried the Jira-tagged publication commit mentioning GF#15707.
additional_context: FHIR-19339 later removed the separate sourceIdentifier path because identifiers are handled through Consent.sourceReference. The current active Consent resource has sourceAttachment/sourceReference and only a source-reference search parameter over Consent.sourceReference.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build no longer has the inconsistent generic Consent.source reference search or a separate source-identifier search parameter.

related_jiras.note: Later Published decision removed Consent.sourceIdentifier and explains the current absence of a token source-identifier parameter.
